app_store.name: Paperhand
app_store.subtitle: Design by hand. No account.
app_store.promotional_text: Posters, posts, slides and invitations from your own photos and type. Nothing locked, no generative AI, and your designs stay on your device.
app_store.description:
Paperhand is a design studio that leaves the making to you.

NO GENERATIVE AI
Every template and illustration in Paperhand is made by hand. It never fills your page with machine-made content.

NOTHING LOCKED
No crowns, no watermarks, no trials, no renewals. Every template, element, font and export is yours to use.

NO ACCOUNT
Open it and start. Your designs and photos stay on your device.

BACKGROUND REMOVAL ON YOUR DEVICE
Cut a subject out of your photo with one tap. It runs on your device, only when you ask, and your photo is never uploaded.

WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
Social posts and stories, presentations, posters, flyers, video thumbnails, banners, business cards, logos, invitations, resumes and certificates: 61 templates to start from, or a blank page at any size.

TOOLS
- 100+ elements: shapes, lines and arrows, illustrations, photo frames, gradients and textures
- 18 open-licensed fonts, text effects, letter spacing and line height
- Photo filters, adjustments, crop and frames
- Multi-page designs, layers, alignment, snapping, undo
- Freehand drawing
- Download PNG, JPG, multi-page PDF or SVG, with transparent backgrounds

Paperhand keeps your work in this app's storage on your device. Remove the app and your designs go with it, so download anything you want to keep.
